chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated from Fadala from Rifa'ah who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who hurries in the two days of Mina, does he cut off the Takbir? He said, 'Yes, after the morning prayer.'

key_terms.التَّكْبِير: The ritual chanting of 'Allahu Akbar' (God is Greatest), specifically in the context of stoning the Jamarat
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a plain near Mecca where pilgrims perform rituals during Hajj

ai.seo_question: When does a pilgrim who leaves Mina early stop reciting Takbir?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific timing for concluding the ritual chanting of 'Takbir' when a pilgrim exercises the concession to depart Mina early on the 12th of Dhu al-Hijjah. It establishes that the cessation occurs immediately after the Fajr prayer, distinguishing this act from the stoning ritual itself and highlighting the flexibility (rukhsah) granted in Hajj rites to accommodate pilgrims' needs.
